mechanism: Foscarnet causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) while captopril reduces glomerular filtration pressure, synergistically increasing acute kidney injury risk and hyperkalemia.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and potassium closely; consider alternative antiviral or antihypertensive agent; ensure adequate hydration and dose adjustment based on creatinine clearance.
